## [Drosophila Population Genomics Project](Ariyah_Walker_D. melanogaster.pdf)
- Analyzed genomic data from Drosophila to investigate patterns of genetic differentiation and identify highly divergent loci
- Worked with SNP-based results and annotations to summarize outlier regions and support biological interpretation
- Created publication-style visualizations to communicate findings clearly in a research poster format

## Network-Based SIR Disease Simulation
- Used flight passenger data to construct an adjacency matrix representing movement between hub US airports
- Developed a SIR simulation to model infectious disease spread across a connected airport network

## Air Quality & ER Visits (Virginia)
- Analyzed the relationship between particulate matter exposure and respiratory-related emergency department visits across Virginia health districts
- Cleaned, merged, and summarized public health and air quality datasets using R
- Built regression models and visualizations to examine trends and support interpretation of results

## [Workforce Demand vs Education (Virginia)](DegreesInDemand.html)
- Compared high-demand occupations in Virginia with degree completion data to evaluate alignment between workforce needs and educational output
- Created visualizations to communicate patterns in job demand, wages, and degree production
- Built an interactive Shiny dashboard to allow users to explore trends by institution type, degree, and program outcomes
